data.definition: Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties.
data.grammar_rule: Use 'vigilant about' for duties, and 'vigilant against' for threats.
examples: Cybersecurity teams must remain vigilant about data breaches.
Be vigilant against fraud attempt emails.
data.common_mistake: ❌ Stay vigilant for threats. ➜ ✅ Stay vigilant against threats.

examples: Fresh water is vital to human survival.
Teamwork is vital for completing the project on time.
data.common_mistake: ❌ Oxygen is vital with life. ➜ ✅ Oxygen is vital to life.

data.definition: Exposed to the possibility of being attacked, harmed, or influenced.
examples: Coastal regions are particularly vulnerable to tropical storms.
Unencrypted files are vulnerable to cyber attacks.
data.common_mistake: ❌ Children are vulnerable for infections. ➜ ✅ Children are vulnerable to infections.

data.definition: An act of going to see a person or place as a guest or tourist.
data.grammar_rule: The noun 'visit TO' takes 'to'. Contrast with the transitive verb 'visit' which takes a direct object with NO preposition.
examples: During our visit to London, we saw Big Ben.
He paid a short visit to his grandmother.
data.common_mistake: ❌ Our visit in the hospital was brief. ➜ ✅ Our visit to the hospital was brief.
data.related_forms: ⚡ Noun: 'a visit TO the museum' ➔ Verb: 'visit' (no prep)

data.definition: The quality or state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed.
examples: The report highlighted the island's vulnerability to extreme weather.
Cybersecurity audits reveal vulnerability to hacking.
data.common_mistake: ❌ Vulnerability for stress. ➜ ✅ Vulnerability to stress.

data.definition: To go to see a person or place for pleasure, business, or social reasons.
data.grammar_rule: Direct transitive verb! Do NOT use 'to'. However, the noun 'visit' takes 'to'.
data.noun_parallel: ⚡ Verb: 'We visited Rome last summer' (no prep) ➔ Noun: 'We paid a visit TO Rome' (uses TO)
examples: We visited our grandparents last weekend.
Thousands of tourists visit the museum every day.
data.common_mistake: ❌ I visited to London. ➔ ✅ I visited London. (OR: I went on a visit to London.)
